summary: Nintendo's kart-racing series, covering mainline console and handheld games, arcade collaborations, mobile, mixed-reality, and the Switch 2 open-world entry.

entries.title: Super Mario Kart

emulation.notes: Use official NSO or accurate SNES emulation.

primary.why: The Switch Online SNES app is the current official route for the original Super Mario Kart while preserving the SNES version.
primary.how_to_play: Play Super Mario Kart through Nintendo Switch Online's SNES library, or via accurate SNES emulation for preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake or expanded edition identified.

entries.title: Mario Kart 64

emulation.notes: Use official NSO or accurate N64 emulation.

primary.why: The Switch Online Expansion Pack release is the current official route for the Nintendo 64 version.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart 64 through the Nintendo Switch Online Nintendo 64 library, or on original hardware/emulation for preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake or expanded edition identified.

entries.title: Mario Kart: Super Circuit
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo Switch Online Game Boy Advance release

emulation.notes: Use official NSO or GBA emulation.

primary.why: The Switch Online Expansion Pack GBA release is the current official route and preserves the handheld game.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart: Super Circuit through Nintendo Switch Online's Game Boy Advance library, or via mGBA for preservation.

entries.title: Mario Kart: Double Dash!!

emulation.notes: Use increased internal resolution and widescreen only if desired.

primary.why: Double Dash remains a GameCube-only mainline Mario Kart with no official modern port identified; Dolphin has the highest fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart: Double Dash!! on GameCube hardware or Dolphin with increased internal resolution.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official modern port identified in this pass.

primary.why: Arcade GP was developed for arcade cabinets and has no home-console release, so arcade hardware is the authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Mario Kart Arcade GP hardware where available.

entries.title: Mario Kart DS

primary.why: Mario Kart DS is a DS-only mainline entry; DS hardware or emulator scaling is the best route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart DS on Nintendo DS/3DS hardware or melonDS/DeSmuME with a clean dual-screen layout.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection features are no longer available through the original service.

primary.why: Arcade GP 2 is an arcade-only release that adds tracks, items, and characters to the Arcade GP line.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Mario Kart Arcade GP 2 hardware where available.

entries.title: Mario Kart Wii

emulation.notes: Use increased internal resolution and a preferred controller setup.

primary.why: Mario Kart Wii remains a Wii release; Dolphin provides the highest-fidelity route while preserving the game.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart Wii on Wii hardware or Dolphin with increased internal resolution.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection features are no longer available through the original service.

entries.title: Mario Kart 7

primary.why: Mario Kart 7 is a 3DS-only mainline entry; 3DS emulation or hardware is the best route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart 7 on Nintendo 3DS hardware or a compatible 3DS emulator with internal-resolution scaling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo 3DS online service status affects original online play.

entries.title: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX
entries.definitive_edition: Current Arcade GP DX cabinet build

primary.why: Arcade GP DX is the most widely distributed Arcade GP entry and remains an arcade-cabinet route with gliding/underwater features and arcade-exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Mario Kart Arcade GP DX hardware where available.

entries.title: Mario Kart 8
entries.definitive_edition: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe with Booster Course Pass

primary.version: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe with Booster Course Pass
primary.why: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe adds content, proper battle arenas, and the Booster Course Pass with 48 additional courses and 8 characters, making it the complete route for Mario Kart 8.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 backward compatibility with the Booster Course Pass installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Wii U original is historically important but lacks the complete Deluxe/DLC package.

entries.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

primary.why: Deluxe is the expanded Switch version of Mario Kart 8, and the Booster Course Pass doubles the course count with 48 additional courses plus 8 characters.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 backward compatibility with the Booster Course Pass installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Booster Course Pass is paid DLC or included through eligible Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack access.

primary.why: Arcade GP VR is a location-based VR arcade entry and has no home release, so the arcade VR installation is the authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play at a supported Mario Kart Arcade GP VR location if available.

entries.title: Mario Kart Tour

primary.why: Tour is a mobile Mario Kart for Android and iOS; it no longer receives new content after October 2023 but remains the authentic mobile route while service is live.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart Tour on supported Android or iOS hardware through the official app.

entries.remaster_caveats: New content ended after October 2023; many Tour courses also appear in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Booster Course Pass and Mario Kart World.

entries.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit

emulation.notes: Use official RC kart hardware with Switch or Switch 2.

primary.why: Home Circuit requires the physical RC kart and uses a Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 to race through a real room, so the hardware bundle is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit kart set with a Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 and the downloadable software.

entries.remaster_caveats: Physical kart battery, camera, and course space are required.

entries.title: Mario Kart World

primary.why: World is the Switch 2-exclusive mainline Mario Kart with a connected world structure, 24-player races, Free Roam, and Knockout Tour.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart World on Nintendo Switch 2 with the latest update installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ongoing updates may change balance, modes, or content; revisit after major DLC or editions.
